policy.name: Chhattisgarh Industrial Development Policy 2024-30 ('Amrit Kaal: Chhattisgarh Vision @2047') - Chapter A, Category A-2 (MSME package), English version updated to notification dated 27.05.2025, read with Amendment No. GEN-2101/1319/2025/COMM.&INDUS dated 12.01.2026
policy.order_no: Department of Commerce & Industries; amendments dated 25.04.2025, 27.05.2025 (Amendment-01, -02), 12.01.2026 (Amendment-04, CG Rajpatra Asadharan No. 17 dated 13.01.2026)

zones.G1: Development Block Group-1 (10 blocks, most developed): Dharsiwa (Raipur); Baloda Bazar, Bhatapara, Simga (Baloda Bazar-Bhatapara); Durg, Dhamdha, Patan (Durg); Raigarh (Raigarh); Akaltara (Janjgir-Champa); Korba (Korba)
zones.G2: Development Block Group-2 (61 blocks) - see Annexure-4
zones.G3: Development Block Group-3 (75 blocks, least developed, mostly Bastar & Surguja divisions) - see Annexure-4

zone_lookup: Annexure-4 'Development Block Categorisation' (policy pp.59-61; clause 12.28(2)) lists every development block of all 33 districts as Group One/Two/Three. Find the unit's development block (tehsil-level block, not the district). Group-1 is listed in full above; any block not in Group-1 is in G2 or G3 per Annexure-4.

schemes.name: Net SGST reimbursement - General MSMEs (OPTION A; alternative to Fixed Capital Investment Subsidy)
schemes.clause: Chapter A, Category A-2, item (1) 'Net SGST Reimbursement' table (policy p.84-85); Annexure-(9.1)
schemes.notes: Net SGST is reimbursed from the date of commercial production. rate_by_zone is the ceiling as a share of fixed capital investment (75% for General enterprises). This is an OPTION: the unit picks EITHER Net SGST reimbursement OR the Fixed Capital Investment Subsidy; the choice is irrevocable, made by an option letter plus affidavit (Note 1, p.85). Covers new units and expansion/diversification/substitution/modernisation. Total incentives under A-2 are capped at 100% of fixed capital investment (A-2 preamble). Clause 12.4(a): women, state-domicile ex-servicemen/Agniveers, Naxal-affected, differently abled, NRI, FDI, exporters and foreign-technology projects get 10% more subsidy, a 10% higher cap, and +1 year on exemptions (only one such category). Ineligible enterprises: Annexure-3.

schemes.name: Net SGST reimbursement - Thrust-sector MSMEs (OPTION A)
schemes.clause: Chapter A, Category A-2, item (1) table, 'Thrust Enterprises' column (p.84-85); thrust list Annexure-2 (p.48)
schemes.notes: Only for products in the Annexure-2 'List of Thrust Sector Enterprises'. The ceiling is 100% of FCI. It is an alternative to the capital subsidy; other conditions as for the general SGST scheme.
conditions: Product is on the thrust-sector list (Annexure-2)

schemes.name: Fixed Capital Investment Subsidy - General MSMEs (OPTION B; alternative to Net SGST)
schemes.clause: Chapter A, Category A-2, 'Fixed Capital Investment Subsidy' table (p.85); instalments (a)-(c); Note (1)-(2)
schemes.notes: The table gives caps in Rs lakh: micro 30/35/40, small 250/350/450, medium 400/450/500 for G1/G2/G3. The base is fixed capital investment as defined in Annexure-1 and the CG Commercial Production Certificate Rules 2024; land treatment per Annexure-1 definitions, not separately checked. Paid as follows: micro in 1 instalment; small in 3 equal annual instalments; medium in 5 equal annual instalments. The first instalment is paid after production starts. Mutually exclusive with Net SGST (irrevocable option). Clause 12.4(a) special categories get +10% of the subsidy and +10% on the cap. Clause 12.4(c) employment multiplier on FCIS and its cap: 1.1x for 100+ permanent jobs, 1.2x for 200+, 1.3x for 500+, 1.4x for 700+, 1.5x for 1000+. Operational rule: CG Sthayi Punji Nivesh Kshatipurti Anudan Niyam 2024 (notification GENS-2101/1167/2025 dated 19.08.2025).

schemes.name: Fixed Capital Investment Subsidy - Thrust-sector MSMEs (OPTION B)
schemes.clause: Chapter A, Category A-2, 'Fixed Capital Investment Subsidy' table, Thrust columns (p.85)
schemes.notes: The table gives caps in Rs lakh: micro 35/40/45, small 350/450/550, medium 700/750/800. Same instalments, option rules and 12.4 add-ons as the general scheme. Thrust list: Annexure-2.
conditions: Product is on the thrust-sector list (Annexure-2)

schemes.name: Interest subsidy on term loans - General MSMEs
schemes.clause: Chapter A, Category A-2, item (2) 'Interest Subsidy' table (p.86-87); Annexure-(9.2)
schemes.notes: rate_by_zone is the share OF INTEREST paid on term loans from RBI-recognised FIs, not percentage points. The annual cap in Rs lakh is micro 15/20/25, small 25/30/35, medium 35/40/45 for G1/G2/G3; the term is 5/6/7 years. Available for new units and expansion/diversification/substitution/modernisation. It is NOT part of the SGST/FCIS either-or option, so it can stack with either, within the overall 100% of FCI cap. 12.4(a) special categories get +10%.

schemes.name: Interest subsidy on term loans - Thrust-sector MSMEs
schemes.clause: Chapter A, Category A-2, item (2) table, Thrust columns (p.86-87)
schemes.notes: Annual cap in Rs lakh: micro 20/25/30, small 30/35/40, medium 40/45/50. Term 6/7/8 years for G1/G2/G3.
conditions: Product is on the thrust-sector list (Annexure-2)

schemes.name: Electricity duty exemption - General MSMEs (new units)
schemes.clause: Chapter A, Category A-2, item (3) 'Electricity Duty Exemption' (p.87-88); Annexure-(9.3)
schemes.notes: Complete exemption from the date of commercial production. The policy text says 'only new enterprises', but the 27.05.2025 amendment adds expansion/diversification pro-rata by additional P&M over total P&M. Exemptions are over and above the 100% FCI incentive cap (12.1). 12.4(a) special categories get +1 year.

schemes.name: Electricity duty exemption - Thrust-sector MSMEs
schemes.clause: Chapter A, Category A-2, item (3), Thrust column (p.87-88)
schemes.notes: Same conditions as the general scheme.
conditions: Product is on the thrust-sector list (Annexure-2)

schemes.name: Quality Certification Subsidy
schemes.clause: Chapter A, Category A-2, item (9) (p.90); Annexure-(9.9); rules notified 14.02.2025 (GENS/32/2025)
schemes.notes: 50% of the cost of ISO-9000/14000/18000/22000, BIS, ZED, BEE, renewable-energy certification, Agmark, Euro standards or similar national/international certification. Max Rs 10 lakh PER CERTIFICATION. Open to new and existing MSMEs.

schemes.name: Environment Management Project Subsidy (carbon-footprint reducing technology)
schemes.clause: Chapter A, Category A-2, item (14), para 17.1 (p.91)
schemes.notes: 50% of the machinery cost of environmental management technology that reduces the carbon footprint, max Rs 25 lakh per technology.

other_benefits: Stamp duty: complete exemption on land/shed/building purchase or lease deeds and on loan deeds within 3 years (A-2 item 4)
Mandi fee: complete exemption for 5 years for new agro/food processing and biofuel MSMEs, max Rs 5 crore/yr and 75% of FCI (A-2 item 5)
Land use conversion (diversion) fee: 50% exemption up to 15 acres for micro and small (A-2 item 6)
Project report subsidy: 1% of FCI up to Rs 10 lakh (A-2 item 8)
Technical patent: 50% up to Rs 20 lakh per patent; technology purchase from NRDC etc.: 50% up to Rs 10 lakh (A-2 items 10-11)
Margin money: 25% of capital cost up to Rs 100 lakh for SC/ST, women, ex-servicemen, Naxal-affected, transgender and PwD micro/small units with capital cost up to Rs 10 crore (A-2 item 12)
Water/energy audit: 50% up to Rs 5 lakh (A-2 item 15)
Export freight to port/airport: 50% up to Rs 50 lakh/yr for 5 years (Rs 60 lakh for SC/ST) (A-2 item 16)
SME exchange listing: 50% up to Rs 10 lakh (A-2 item 18)
Thrust-sector training reimbursement: one month's salary up to Rs 15,000 per domicile employee for 5 years (A-2 item 19)
EPF reimbursement (Amendment-04, 12.01.2026, new para 21 of Annexure-9): thrust-sector MSMEs get 75% of the employer EPF contribution for CG employees for 5 years, max 2% of eligible FCI per year
Employment subsidy for PwD/retired Agniveers/surrendered Naxals: 40% of net salary up to Rs 5 lakh/yr for 5 years (A-2 item 13)
SC/ST land premium: 100% exemption plus Re 1/acre lease rent in CSIDC areas (A-2 item 20). The general land premium concession (A-2 item 17) was deleted by Amendment-04 ('Annexure-9 para 17 omitted')
